display_long_description:
🔳 QR Scanner & Generator turns your Meta Quest 3 / 3S into a fast, hands-free QR & barcode reader — and a full generator — inside a sleek holographic HUD.

  📷 SCAN
  ▸ Point at any QR or barcode — detected instantly through passthrough, no phone needed
  ▸ One-tap smart actions: open links, join Wi-Fi, save contacts, dial, maps, calendar
  ▸ Built-in offline safety check warns about phishing & suspicious links

  ✨ GENERATE
  ▸ Create QR codes for links, Wi-Fi & text with the in-VR keyboard
  ▸ Save them to your headset's Downloads folder

  📋 ORGANIZE
  ▸ Searchable history of everything you scan & generate — favorites, notes, re-actions
  ▸ Export to PDF, CSV, JSON or TXT

  🧊 MADE FOR MIXED REALITY
  ▸ Multi-panel holographic workspace you can grab & arrange
  ▸ Comfortable & stationary — seated or standing
  ▸ Runs on-device only: no ads, no accounts, no trackers

  💬 Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/u76eFWjeV

  ⚠ Scanning uses Meta's Passthrough Camera API — requires Quest 3 or Quest 3S
